classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wb_measured.des: Your full-strength blows build more Composure, and at full Composure you hit a little harder, each rank.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wb_riposte.desc: A blow within a second of a block or a parry hits half again as hard and staggers the foe.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wb_board.desc: Your shield bashes stagger, and blocks and parries build twice the Composure.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wb_two_handed.d: Your two-handed swings sweep wider (the cleave reaches half again as far and takes one more foe) and pierce armour: the more a foe wears, the harder they land.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wb_read.desc: At full Composure your parry window is twice as wide.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wb_commander.de: Your orders reach twice as far, and your hirelings and companions follow them even if they don't speak your tongue.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wb_duelist.desc: 30% more damage while only one foe is near you.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wb_perfect.desc: At full Composure, J spends it all on your next blow (within 5 seconds): it can't be parried, hits twice as hard and staggers anything. A boss is brought to its knee.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wb_blood_up.des: Your Rage builds faster, and each rank your blows hit harder the fuller it is.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wb_pain_feeds.d: Blows you take while raging heal a sliver back.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wb_reckless.des: With no shield in hand, you hit 25% harder while raging.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wb_juggernaut.d: Heavy armour weighs nothing while you rage.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wb_shrug.desc: While raging, nothing knocks you back and nothing staggers you.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wb_blackout.des: While raging you can't go down: blows leave you on your feet until the rage runs out.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wb_bloodlust.de: Each kill while raging fills your Rage again and gives back some health.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wb_rampage.desc: While raging, J spends your Rage: for 8 seconds every blow cleaves through the foes round the one you hit. Then you're spent, slow and weak for a while.
